title: EnzySFC discovers nitrile-hydratase activity in nitrilases and evolves amide-selective variants
summary: The AI-assisted EnzySFC workflow experimentally validated 10 previously uncharacterized nitrilases selected from 1,113 candidates. A wild-type Phototrophicales nitrilase showed exclusive nitrile hydratase activity; a separate Actinomycetia nitrilase was AI-evolved, with four tested top variants reaching 100% amide yield and complete substrate conversion.
ai_technology: EnzySFC AI-assisted enzyme discovery and functional-evolution platform
organization: China State Institute of Pharmaceutical Industry, Research Center for Systems Biosynthesis

evidence.tested: The AI-assisted EnzySFC workflow experimentally validated 10 previously uncharacterized nitrilases selected from 1,113 candidates.
evidence.unknown: The reported outcomes are enzyme and substrate assays; the abstract does not establish industrial scale performance or application in a living system. The 10 discovery candidates and 16 mutants were experimental follow-ups to model prioritization, not comprehensive validation of all 1,113 sequences.
evidence.ai_role: EnzySFC combined de novo enzyme discovery and multiobjective activity/specificity optimization to rank candidate nitrilases and propose evolved mutants. The study experimentally tested ten discovery candidates and sixteen mutants from one evolution prediction cycle; the named activity switch and product-selective variants were measured in assays.
